subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 4/4] nfsd-iomode-advisor: recommend read_io= and write_io= for an export

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch adds a tool called nfsd-iomode-advisor that recommends the optimal IO mode (buffered, dontcache, or direct) for an NFS export based on various metrics and thresholds. The tool samples metrics while clients use the export, including miss ratio, reclaim vs storage traffic, CPU time of kswapd/kcompactd threads, dirty/writeback ratios, free memory, and average READ/WRITE sizes. It then uses these metrics to recommend the optimal IO mode for READ and WRITE operations, taking into account factors such as server size, storage type, and kernel limits. The tool also probes the export with preadv2 and statx to ensure that NFSD does not silently fall back from a recommended mode.
